discription: A basic sawtooth wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a subtle vibrato.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, vibratoRate=5, vibratoDepth=0.005; var sig, env, vib; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); vib = SinOsc.ar(vibratoRate) * (freq * vibratoDepth); sig = Saw.ar(freq + vib); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
